uboot_env.before: the id that load_hisilicon detected on first boot and saved; insert_sns does not list it (value not recorded)

/etc/majestic.yaml.note: only isp.blkCnt; the firmware ships no majestic.yaml

findings.load_hisilicon: with sensor=ar0141 it sets the sensor clock to 24 MHz (0x20030030=0x1) and loads the modules after the sensor; majestic picks /etc/sensors/ar0141_i2c_720p.ini and libsns_ar0140.so, IQ default.ini

bayer.method: sensor test pattern 0x3070=1 (solid colour), red channel 0x3072 only, JPEG snapshot means

cold_start.symptom: first majestic after boot: VI IntCnt stays 0, 'Timeout from venc channel 0'; every later start works
cold_start.cause: the VIU keeps its port/channel enable bits (0x20580100, 0x20581000) only while the sensor drives PIXCLK; majestic enables the VI before the sensor init, and the AR0141 is in soft standby after power-up
cold_start.reproduced_by: clearing the stream bit of 0x301A before starting majestic
cold_start.workaround: S96vicheck: if the VI is configured but no frame arrives for 8 s, restart majestic once

mid_stream_stall.seen_after: repeated sensor test-pattern changes over I2C while streaming
mid_stream_stall.symptom: VIU registers read 0, IntCnt frozen, JPEG 503, majestic still running
mid_stream_stall.monitor: S96vicheck polls IntCnt every 10 s; same majestic PID and no change for 30 s -> restart; up to 3 in a row, then every 600 s; a new PID resets the observation

log: VI configured but no frame from the sensor (cold start); restarting majestic once
video input running after one restart

sensor_stop_test.action: clear the stream bit of 0x301A while streaming
sensor_stop_test.log_last: video input running again after 2 restart(s)

open_issues: IQ is OpenIPC default.ini (no AR0141 tuning)
night mode GPIOs (IR-cut, IR LED) not investigated
